README: ROOTS-AI™ C-01 Canonical Question Bank v1.0.1

APPROVED EXECUTABLE DATASET • Exactly 73 questions across exactly 13 ordered modules. Participant-facing English copy is authoritative. This proprietary beta wellness assessment is educational and non-diagnostic; it is not represented as a clinically validated diagnostic instrument.
Persist with every response and report

Implementation sequence: validate workbook checksum → import Modules → import Option_Sets → import Questions → apply Validation → run QA_Checks → publish version 1.0.1.
Modules: Module IDs, titles and question ranges are immutable for questionnaire version 1.0.1.
